description: Counterfactual for the Worksheet B scenario, TY2025 MFJ 70,000, 2 children, no Form 5695: CTC limited to the full tax 4,146; ACTC = min(4,400 - 4,146 = 254, 3,400) = 254; net = -254. (With the 3,000 solar credit the refund rises by exactly 3,000: the credit displaces nonrefundable CTC into the ACTC.)
